summary: Reviewed all 35 enriched units (37-71); 22 changed in word glosses, rest unchanged. Identifications checked and judged correct with sensible tags: jīmūtaka = Luffa echinata (devadālī/bandāl), āragvadha, paṭolī, ikṣu, śatāvarī, bilva, ikṣvāku/tumbī = Lagenaria siceraria (bitter form for ikṣvāku, flagged as not stated in text), kuṭaja = Holarrhena pubescens (Hindi kuṛā; seeds indrayava), kṛtavedhana = Luffa acutangula (probable), jīvantī = Leptadenia reticulata, jīvaka/ṛṣabhaka = Malaxis (disputed), tumbaru = Zanthoxylum armatum (tejbal), kāsamarda = Senna occidentalis (disputed), dhāmārgava left as disputed Luffa, madanaphala, arka, madhūka, sarṣapa, trikaṭuka. The jīvanīya list in unit 61 is explicitly labelled as Caraka's and not as this book's (correct). The unit-59 'four' inference is explicitly marked as inference not stated in text (acceptable). Hindi fields contain no Latin letters or brackets. Low-confidence units 44, 51, 58 untouched; 54, 57, 59, 63, 67 only lightly enriched with the readings kept low (acceptable). Issues: 1 error (unit 48 Hindi smuggles 'जलोदर समेत'), 4 minor (units 57 x2, 62 x2... see list; unit 67 latex). No regrouping suggested. Not flagged but noted: vātaśoṇita = vātarakta 'gout-type' and śvayathu = swelling/oedema are acceptable; 'kuṣṭha ... including leprosy' and 'pīnasa -> जुकाम' in Hindi are mildly interpretive but standard and consistent across units.
